name: LOLDrivers (Living Off The Land Drivers catalogue)
tier_rationale: Well-known community catalogue of vulnerable and malicious Windows drivers (magicsword-io, public GitHub repository and API since 2023, Apache-2.0): A8 community. Offline use only (the module has disclosure none: tier n/a).

reliability.justification: Curated catalogue with per-entry 'Verified' flags; exact file and Authenticode hashes are the blocking indicators ('Tags are hunting names', IndicatorSemantics), so only hash matches become findings (P268 cond 4).

dataset.title: LOLDrivers drivers.json (driver catalogue: category, verified, ATT&CK ids, CVEs, sample and Authenticode hashes)

terms.quote: Apache License Version 2.0, January 2004 (LICENSE of magicsword-io/LOLDrivers, fetched 2026-11-26)

dataset.notes: https://www.loldrivers.io/api/drivers.json (36 MB on 2026-11-26: 713 drivers, 12,362 distinct hashes). Downloaded only by `v3lum data update` (large: never during a scan, A6 BR9) and indexed into a slim hash projection (P268 cond 3); attributed in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES (notice lol_datasets_loldrivers). Driver pages link sample binaries (drivers/<md5>.bin): never fetched.

notes: Owned by batch p2-G07-1 (P268). Dataset host only (GitHub Pages behind loldrivers.io); www.loldrivers.io is also the host of the manual driver pages (threat_intel_g07_p2:loldrivers_search).
